results.name: Brazilian Crunches
instructions: Begin in a plank position on your toes and hands, arms straight in line with shoulders, with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your left elbow while lightly rotating your hips. Return your leg to starting position.

Repeat the movement on the opposite side, bending your left knee and bringing it towards your right elbow while lightly rotating your hips. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your movements controlled to ensure each repetition is deliberate and effective.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you bring your knee towards your elbow and inhaling as you return to the plank.
Focus on maintaining proper plank form, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.
results.description: Brazilian Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Bridge - Mountain Climber (Cross Body)
instructions: Begin in a plank position on your toes and hands, with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your left elbow while lightly rotating your hips, stop when your knee passes the elbow.
Return to the starting plank position, then repeat the movement on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure you keep your movements smooth and controlled to maintain form and avoid injury.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you bring your knee towards your elbow and inhaling as you return to the plank position.
Keep your shoulders stable and your core engaged throughout the exercise to enhance effectiveness.
results.description: Bridge - Mountain Climber (Cross Body) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Cable Standing Crunch
instructions: Stand facing away from a high cable pulley with the rope positioned behind your neck. Hold the rope with arms beside your head with your feet shoulder width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Contract your abdominal muscles and curl your torso downward by bringing your rib cage toward your pelvis while keeping your hips nearly stationary.
Pause briefly at the bottom while squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Slowly return your torso to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hands beside your head without pulling on the rope with your arms.
Flex your spine to initiate the movement instead of hinging at your hips.
Keep your neck in a neutral position and avoid excessive forward head movement.
Inhale as you return to the starting position and exhale as you curl your torso downward.
results.description: Cable Standing Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

results.name: Cable Twist (Up-Down)
instructions: Stand sideways to the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart. Attach a handle to the high pulley and grasp it with both hands, arms extended diagonally along the cable.
Twist your torso down and across your body, pulling the handle down towards your opposite hip while keeping your arms straight.
Slowly return to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce injury risk.
Exhale as you twist away from the machine and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Minimize hip twisting to focus on engaging your obliques and core during the twist.
results.description: Cable Twist (Up-Down) is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders.

results.name: Cable Twist
instructions: Stand sideways to the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart. Attach a handle to the pulley at shoulder height and grasp it with both hands, arms extended in front of you.
Twist your torso away from the machine, pulling the handle across your body while keeping your arms straight.
Slowly return to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce injury risk.
Exhale as you twist away from the machine and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Minimize hip twisting to focus on engaging your obliques and core during the twist.
results.description: Cable Twist is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders.

results.name: Captains Chair Leg Raise
instructions: Stand on the platform of the captain's chair and place your forearms on the arm pads, gripping the handles for stability. Allow your legs to hang straight down.
Engage your core and keep your back pressed against the back pad.
Raise your legs, knees first, up in front of you until your thighs are parallel to the floor and your feet are slightly forward.
Slowly lower your knees back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you raise your knees and inhale as you lower them back down.
Avoid using momentum; the movement should be controlled and deliberate.
Focus on engaging your core muscles throughout the movement.
results.description: Captains Chair Leg Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: Captains Chair Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Stand on the platform of the captain's chair and place your forearms on the arm pads, gripping the handles for stability. Allow your legs to hang straight down.
Engage your core and keep your back pressed against the back pad.
Raise your legs straight up in front of you until they are parallel to the floor, keeping them as straight as possible.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back pressed against the back pad to prevent swinging and maintain proper form.
Avoid using momentum; the movement should be controlled and deliberate.
Exhale as you raise your legs and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Captains Chair Straight Leg Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: Chest Lift With Rotation
instructions: Begin by lying on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows wide.
Engage your core and lift your upper body into a crunch position, holding the contraction at the top.
While holding the crunch, rotate your torso to the right. Return to the center.
Lower your upper body back to the floor, then repeat the movement, this time rotating to the left. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; use your abdominal muscles to lift and rotate your torso.
Keep your elbows wide to ensure you are using your core muscles rather than your arms.
Make sure your lower back remains pressed against the floor throughout the exercise.
results.description: Chest Lift With Rotation is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side and rest your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Place your top leg on a bench at knee or ankle height, with your bottom leg hanging free underneath.
Press your forearm and top leg down to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line, and raise your bottom leg toward the bench.
Hold the position while breathing steadily, then lower your hips with control and switch sides.
tips: Keep your hips stacked; don't let them roll forward or back.
Start with the bench under your knee and progress to the ankle as you get stronger.
results.description: Copenhagen Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the adductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Crab Twist Toe Touch
instructions: Begin by sitting on the floor with your legs bent, feet flat on the floor, and hands placed behind you with your fingers pointing towards your body.
Engage your glutes and press through your palms and feet to lift your hips off the floor, creating a tabletop position with your body.
Simultaneously lift your right hand and left foot off the floor and twist your torso to reach your right hand towards your left foot, attempting to touch your left toe.

Return your hand and leg to the floor and repeat the movement on the opposite side by lifting your left hand and reaching towards your right foot. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Perform the twist with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Ensure your shoulders remain down and away from your ears to avoid unnecessary strain.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you twist and reach towards your toe and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Use a mat or soft surface to support your hands and feet to prevent discomfort during the exercise.
results.description: Crab Twist Toe Touch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Core.
